notes.title: Heroes Must Diee
notes.content:
Heroes must diee is a Tower defense game with a few ingredients of RTS, RPG and resource management, but it is still essentially a Tower defense game.
The story revolves around a humble villager who just wants to live in peacefully in his house but the frequent visits from "Heroes" / "Adventurers" on quests looting his house to replenish their inventories has made him a "grinch" and now he just wants to kill them all !
In his ordeal to stop these heroes into doing whatever they desire, the humble villager unknowingly creates a dungeon and that is what the game is about.

The game currently has a brief intro and a complete sandbox mode for the demo. 
The game will have these features in the future / final game
- Hiring minions
- Giving minions jobs
- Inventory system
- Crafting
- More in depth resource management
- Player attacking heroes himself


I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Update - Mid June
notes.content:
Hey all !

With the steam games festival coming up I've been trying to fix up stuff and get a good build ready for everyone to try out !
I'm glad to say that so far we are good to go !

I can't wait for the games festival to begin and people trying out my game.

Improvements made : 

- Added visibility to connections, wired look
- Coin and other resources disappearing when fallen out of a tree or other sources.
- Made resource breaking quicker
- Added variations to enemies
- Stone walls now stop projectiles as it should be.
- Made couple of quests to kick-start the beginning of the game.
- Completely removed Motion blur
- Markets are now expensive (x10 times)
- Player can now also sell to markets
- Consumable Traps are here !


There were plenty bugs which have been removed or worked around so players wont see them in game.

I will be live streaming on Steam or Twitch everyday for the Steam games Festival from 11am-2pm PDT.

Enjoy the festival and stay safe !
